action_summary: Round 4 counted 54 of 145 capabilities NOT_CALLABLE at grounded_action_v1.act and made binding arity/selector defaults the top availability item. This round pre-registered five predictions, then measured the SAME 145 keyword goals at BOTH layers: the chain executor (act) and the sentence door (live_brain_route_admission_v1.solve), from a disposable clone so the tree's own state files never moved. Act reproduces round 4 (SELECTED 64 / NOT_CALLABLE 53 / PRECONDITION 12). The door has no binding class at all: EXECUTED 24, COMPILED_TO_SELF_BUT_FAILED 39 (self total 63), NOT_COMPILED 52 with statuses compilation-gap 33 + effect-unserved 17 + confinement 2, ROUTED_ELSEWHERE 26. The layers disagree in both directions (3 act-refused reach execution at the door; 17 act-selected are refused at the door; precondition-executed cell is empty). Predictions: P1 (door strictly more) FALSIFIED 63<=64, P2 (more than half of 53 routed elsewhere) FALSIFIED 26/53=49%, P3 (door failures are plan/selection) HOLDS, P4 (git salad row executes) FALSIFIED -- realistic git sentences pass separately, measured (read the git log compiles git.repository.operate.v1, op=log, executed and verified), P5 (<=5 raises) HOLDS at 4. The four most-advanced dispatcher sentences were then traced to their exact gates: the extract-constant sentence was one article away from its family trigger ('extract constant' vs 'extract the constant') and this round adds the measured phrase so _resolve_family admits python.swe.transform_and_synthesize.v1 with operation=extract_constant and build_plan is decisive (4/4 pins); diagnose-the-root-cause needs the derivation phrase 'find the root cause' and ends at the deliberate confinement boundary (find_root_cause runs the suite, not static); ruff-lint has no lint operation in polyglot's enum and needs a diff_path plus an admitted command path; format-with-ruff reaches the composer and stops at the same boundary. The fix shipped is the one phrase whose whole chain then reaches its next NAMED gate (the egraph baseline probe SIGKILL rc=-9); everything else is documented with file:line evidence, not guessed at.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner directive 2026-11-12: determine what is real about instant learning and advanced coding/computer-use actions, kill bad ideas before implementation, think from first principles, maximize use of the latest research, and always push and merge completed work. This change executes round 8's standing prescription -- grow the operator space deliberately and pay for it in code -- as one priced, pre-registered measurement. Zero spend, zero model dependency, no governance change, no sentience claim.
